# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c29 P1](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v1 c29 P8](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora has fair, light-colored, ethereal-looking hair and a pale, delicate face.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000)_

## Personality

Honora has a light, ethereal appearance, but she is actually full of mischief, jokes, and humor. She possesses a keen sense of fun and loves to share a good joke, despite her delicate and fair looks.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000)_

## Traits

- Mischievous and humorous  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Ambitious student  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Proficient at writing and essay composition  <sub>[v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To succeed academically at Regent's Academy and compete for honors  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## History

Honora attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, where she proved herself an intelligent student. She eventually advanced to Regent's Academy in Port Marlow to prepare for the Entrance examinations and higher studies. There, she became close friends with Nell Harcourt, Mabel Colby, and Cressida Lindsay. During the term, she took part in various academic competitions, field days, and social events, forming a close-knit group of friends with her fellow students. After the school year, she invited Nell to stay at her aunt's residence, Beechwood, during their time in town.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000), [v1 c29 P19](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0019), [v1 c34 P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Background by volume

- She has a famous aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, who is a published author.  <sub>[v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c29 P1](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0001)</sub>
- She attended the same school as Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow before moving on to Regent's Academy.  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
